title: Bluetooth LE and GATT

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “Bluetooth LE and GATT” to a real program or device. The key principle is: GATT organizes data into services and characteristics. In a project, follow this guidance: Read-only characteristics can still expose sensitive data; consider pairing and authorization.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.

EXPECTED RESULT

CORE EXPLANATION

BLE GATT exposes data through services and characteristics. Advertising, connections, MTU, and power behavior vary by chip and SDK; define access control for each characteristic.

The BLE sketch uses the Arduino-ESP32 BLE library, whose headers and API vary by core version. ESP-IDF's GATT API has a different callback and lifecycle model; this sketch does not claim source compatibility.
